verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS workspace product, but nothing in the evidence shows Notion offers a self-hostable deployment of its core product. The only self-hosting mention is the open-source notion-mcp-server, which is an adjacent integration component, not the core product. A community user also describes Notion as tied to its own cloud service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
